name: tenon-topnav-layout
title: 顶部导航布局
description: 导航在顶栏，内容居中或全宽，窄屏时导航收进抽屉。

files.content:
// 顶部导航：导航在顶栏，内容居中或全宽，适合页面少的用户端。窄屏时导航收进抽屉。 import { Slot, type TabsOutletProps, useNarrow, useNavigation } from "@go-tenon/shell" import { ChevronDown, Menu } from "lucide-react" import type { ReactNode } from "react" import { MenuIcon, NavLink } from "@/components/tenon/nav" import { LayoutContent } from "@/components/tenon/tab-bar" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu" import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sheet" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" /** TopNavLayout 的选项。 */ export interface TopNavLayoutProps { title: string logo?: ReactNode /** 内容限宽居中（默认）还是全宽。 */ width?: "contained" | "full" tabs?: boolean | TabsOutletProps } /** 顶部导航布局。插槽：brand、search、actions、tenant、user 在顶栏，footer 在页脚。 */ export function TopNavLayout({ title, logo, width = "contained", tabs }: TopNavLayoutProps): ReactNode { const { menu, active } = useNavigation() const narrow = useNarrow() const link = (active_: boolean) => cn( "inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-muted", active_ ? "font-medium text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground", ) const nav = menu.map((item) => item.children ? ( {item.title} {item.children.map((child) => ( {child.title} ))} ) : ( {item.title} ), ) const container = width === "contained" ? "mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4" : "w-full px-4" return (
{narrow && ( {title}
{menu.flatMap((item) => (item.children ?? [item]).map((leaf) => ( {leaf.title} )), )}
)}
{logo} {title}
{!narrow &&
{nav}
}
) }
